answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nectar of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, forfeited on duplicate submission, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Work waits on the ridge until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ferrous of the next round.
